records.note: Zlib and Unicode-3.0 findings were resolved by the owner decision. The fixed CPU Python build still requires target-lexicon 0.13.6 through pyo3-build-config 0.29.3. Its exact license expression Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception is outside the closed list; no additional expression or exception was approved. This is a policy boundary, not a claim of a paid/nonfree dependency. The additional permissions in the LLVM text were not silently treated as a new approved SPDX expression. No alternate version was substituted.
